settings.title: Automatic game check-in
settings.description: Configure game check-in credentials for five platforms. Selected platforms run in-game check-in when a user script actually starts.
field.enabled_description: Keep the configuration without running check-in when disabled.
field.cn_games_description: Select games on Miyoushe CN; optional.
field.os_games_description: Select games on HoYoLAB global; optional.
field.skland_games_description: Select games on Skland CN; optional.
field.skport_games_description: Select games on SKPORT global; optional.
field.cnCookie_description: Copy the complete cookie from a Miyoushe web request, including stoken, mid, and uid login fields.
field.cnCookie_placeholder: Complete Miyoushe cookie with stoken, mid, and uid login fields
field.osCookie_description: Copy the complete cookie from a HoYoLAB web request, including ltoken and ltuid.
field.osCookie_placeholder: Complete HoYoLAB cookie with ltoken and ltuid
field.sklandToken_description: Get the token from an Arknights Skland APP passport request and enter the token text.
field.sklandToken_placeholder: Arknights passport token captured from the Skland APP
field.skportToken_description: Get the passport token from an Endfield global / SKPORT request and enter it here.
field.kuroToken_description: Get the token from a Kuro APP request. The scope is in-game check-in.
field.kuroToken_placeholder: Token captured from a Kuro APP request
field.last_status_description: Result of the latest actual attempt.
